item.title: CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent
item.description: PRESS RELEASE New Delhi, 29.9.2026 CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) organised a live webinar on “Relevance of Registration & LOC” today at the Auditorium, CBSE Integrated Office, Dwarka, New Delhi. The webinar was organised in continuation of CBSE’s circulars relating to the submission of the List of Candidates (LOC) for the Class X and Class XII Board Examinations 2027 and correction of demo
